final_message:
I rewrote the skill's description, but I haven't tested the change yet, so I can't say it fixes the problem.

**The cause:** the description was `Helps with parquet files.` Before an agent loads any skill, the description is the only thing it sees apart from the name. That text doesn't say when the skill applies and uses none of the words an agent has in mind when it's about to write a file. So nothing ever matched it.

**The change** (`skills/parquet-schema-check/SKILL.md:3`):

```yaml
description: Use when writing or appending a parquet file for a dataset that has a schema in schemas/, before calling to_parquet, write_parquet or pyarrow write_table, or when a downstream job fails reading a parquet file on mismatched columns or dtypes
```

- It states only when to use the skill. It doesn't summarise the steps; a description that does tends to get followed in place of the skill itself, which would lose the "don't cast to make them match" rule.
- It names what the agent sees at the moment the skill should trigger: writing or appending, the `schemas/` folder, and the three write functions (`to_parquet`, `write_parquet`, `write_table`). It also names what happens after a bad write: a later job fails on mismatched columns or dtypes.
- The main trigger fits in the first 160 characters, because some tools (Codex, for example) cut descriptions to about that length when they list many skills.

The skill's instructions themselves are unchanged.

**Still to do:**
1. **Test the change.** I couldn't start subagents in this turn. Please rerun the baseline scenarios with the new description and check whether agents now load the skill before the write. If some still don't, tell me which ones and I'll tighten the wording.
2. **License field is missing.** The repo's rule requires `license` in the frontmatter of every skill. Neither skill has one, and I found no LICENSE file, so I didn't guess a value. Tell me which license to use.
3. **Baseline record.** There's no file in the repo with the earlier baseline results. If you want them kept, tell me where and I'll write them outside the skill folder, since everything inside it ships with the skill.

Nothing has been committed.
